about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Junior Software Engineer, MLSA, and community builder from Comayagua, Honduras.
about.intro: My name is Fernando Rivera. I was born in 2007 in Comayagua, Honduras, and I've been drawn to technology for as long as I can remember. It all started the day I opened a random batch script full of commands I didn't understand. Instead of ignoring it, I began experimenting, changing lines, breaking it, copying it, fixing it again. That process of trial and error hooked me. Since then, I've kept building, learning, and creating projects that satisfy my constant curiosity and need to understand how things work.
about.empowering_text: I don't usually build the software people already use. I focus on teaching them how to actually use it well. And when the right tool doesn't exist to solve a problem, I create it. I run workshops focused on practical software usage and improving digital literacy, making technology feel approachable instead of intimidating.
about.events_text: As a Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador, I designed and led a 10-session course reaching 250+ students nationwide, covering AI fundamentals, cloud computing, and collaborative programming. I've also organized events like MSLA Comayagua 2024, and lead workshops at my university ranging from digital literacy to in-depth tech courses.
about.philosophy_text: Everything I do is grounded in open-source values and community-driven learning. Motivation and discipline matter more than talent alone.
about.goals_text: Continue growing my work while developing into a strong, capable professional. Keep refining skills, diving into new technologies, and building solutions that are useful and meaningful.
about.quote: Don't feel intimidated, find motivation and discipline within your dreams.
about.acknowledgments_text: To everyone who has been there throughout this journey — your support, feedback, and belief kept me moving forward. I genuinely appreciate all of it.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A curated selection of things I've built. Each one solves a real problem or scratches a particular curiosity.

census.name: Bus Routes Census
census.description: A form-based data collection app where students submit their entry/exit times and drop a pin on an interactive map. Responses are visualized through heatmaps and aggregated statistics, giving planners actionable insights to optimize university bus routes based on real student demand.

editor.name: Bus Route Editor
editor.description: A real-time campus transportation platform featuring an interactive bus route editor and live GPS tracking. Students can view active routes and the current location of buses on a map. Includes a custom-configured companion device running a purpose-built app to transmit live GPS data.

expedientes.name: Sistema de Expedientes
expedientes.description: A secure medical records management system built in strict compliance with ISO/IEC 27001 standards. Features a deep, multi-layered access control model combining RBAC and ABAC, comprehensive audit trails, real-time alerts, and full traceability across all record interactions.

pumai.name: PumAI — AI Inquiry Assistant
pumai.description: An LLM-powered assistant built to handle student inquiries with accurate, context-aware responses. Features RAG support for institutional knowledge retrieval, MCP server integration, and deterministic workflows for guided processes — enabling autonomous actions and step-by-step student guidance.

curc.name: UNAH CURC — Institutional Website
curc.description: The official website for UNAH's Campus Comayagua, serving 3,000+ students. Redesigned and developed to improve structure, accessibility, and usability — covering academic offerings, student services, administrative directories, transparency resources, and campus information.

personal.name: Personal Website
personal.description: A representation of my current skills, serving as a portal for my projects and internet persona. Contains a hub for my social media and portfolio of work.

flashet.name: Flashet
flashet.description: Study aid app built with React and Node.js. Create flashcard decks to help prepare for exams with an intuitive interface and progress tracking.

zappit.name: Zappit
zappit.description: Twitter-like social media platform built with Next.js and Node.js. Features include posts, follows, likes, real-time updates, and user profiles.

songsurf.name: SongSurf
songsurf.description: A microservices-based app using the Spotify API and built-in datasets to find songs matching user-defined parameters. Built with pandas and Next.js.

ascloud.name: AsCloud
ascloud.description: Open source cloud storage service. A platform for file storage and sharing with a clean interface and RESTful API.

miichi.name: Mi-ichi
miichi.description: Arduino-controlled 12-DOF robocat inspired by Boston Dynamics. Controlled using bluetooth and servomotors.

dimlim.name: DIMLIM
dimlim.description: End-to-end encrypted chat application built with Next.js. Features secure messaging, user authentication, and real-time communication.
